extension.description: Reviews skills-check-updates (scu) runs that change installed agent skills. --upgrade reinstalls skills listed in skills-lock.json from their GitHub sources through the skills CLI, rewrites the skill folders under .agents/skills and .claude/skills and updates skills-lock.json; --force overwrites local edits instead of merging them. Read-only reports and direct runs with --help, -h, --version or -v are not matched (launcher forms stay in review). Covers the scu and skills-check-updates executables and npx, bunx, pnpx, pnpm, yarn, npm exec, npm x, bun x, pnpm dlx and yarn dlx launches, including versioned launches (skills-check-updates@tag).
extension.name: skills-check-updates command protection

permissions.description: Identifies scu --upgrade runs that reinstall agent skills from GitHub, rewrite their folders and update skills-lock.json.
permissions.label: skills-check-updates skill upgrade
safer_guidance: Run scu without --upgrade first: it only reports which skills changed upstream.
Run scu --details <skill> to read the upstream commits and changed files before updating.
Add --min-age 7d to hold back upstream changes that are younger than a week.

permissions.description: Identifies scu --upgrade --force runs that replace locally edited skills with the upstream version.
permissions.label: skills-check-updates forced overwrite
safer_guidance: Run scu --upgrade without --force: it merges local edits with upstream changes and skips skills whose changes overlap.
Back up or commit the local skill folders before overwriting them.

rules.description: Identifies scu --upgrade (-u) runs. They run npx skills add for every outdated skill, which downloads the skills CLI from npm and skill files from GitHub, rewrite the installed skill folders that agents load as instructions and update skills-lock.json. Skills with local edits are merged with git merge-file or skipped when the changes overlap. Covers the scu and skills-check-updates executables and npx, bunx, pnpx, pnpm, yarn, npm exec, npm x, bun x, pnpm dlx and yarn dlx launches, including versioned launches (skills-check-updates@tag).
safer_alternatives: Run scu without --upgrade first: it only reports which skills changed upstream.
Run scu --details <skill> to read the upstream commits and changed files before updating.
Add --min-age 7d to hold back upstream changes that are younger than a week.
rules.title: skills-check-updates skill upgrade

rules.description: Identifies scu --upgrade --force (-u -f) runs. Instead of merging, they reinstall every outdated or locally edited skill from upstream and discard local edits to those skills. --force without --upgrade changes nothing and is not matched. Covers the scu and skills-check-updates executables and npx, bunx, pnpx, pnpm, yarn, npm exec, npm x, bun x, pnpm dlx and yarn dlx launches, including versioned launches (skills-check-updates@tag).

Back up or commit the local skill folders before overwriting them.
